title: Senior Pricing Data Scientist
description:
Senior Pricing Data Scientist

London (Hybrid) | £70,000 - £80,000 + Bonus + Benefits

This is an excellent opportunity to join a highly analytical insurance pricing team where your work will directly influence commercial strategy. You'll have the freedom to develop sophisticated pricing models, work with large datasets, and drive business performance through data-driven decision making.

The Company

They are a data-led organisation that places analytics at the heart of commercial decision-making. With a collaborative culture and modern technology stack, they offer an environment where innovation and experimentation are encouraged.

The Role

  • Develop and enhance conversion, elasticity, and market pricing models.
  • Apply statistical modelling and machine learning techniques to improve pricing performance.
  • Analyse market and competitor data to support pricing strategy.
  • Partner with trading and commercial teams to optimise business outcomes.
  • Deliver actionable insights using Python and SQL.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience in insurance pricing.
  • Expertise in conversion modelling, elasticity modelling, or market modelling.
  • Advanced Python and SQL skills.
  • Strong statistical and machine learning knowledge.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills.

What They Offer

  • £70,000 - £80,000 base salary.
  • Annual bonus and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Hybrid working in London.
  • Strong learning and development opportunities.
  • High levels of ownership and visibility across the business.

How to Apply

Apply today to learn more about this Senior Pricing Data Scientist opportunity.
